info.name: Red Hat 3scale Account Management Accounts OAuth API

params.name: provider_key
params.description: The provider key identifying your 3scale account

params.name: access_token
params.description: The OAuth 2.0 access token to authorize

params.name: service_id
params.description: The ID of the service being accessed

items.docs: Authorizes an OAuth 2.0 access token against the 3scale service, checking whether the token is valid and within usage limits. Returns the application and plan details associated with the token.
